description: This file contains functions and constants for validation and sanitization of device-related data in a network device inventory web application. It includes regex validation for IPv4 addresses, device type normalization, payload sanitization, and validation functions for create and update operations.

methods.name: str _truncate(value: str, field: str)
methods.description: Truncates string value to maximum length specified for a given field.

methods.name: bool validate_ipv4(ip: str)
methods.description: Validates if a given string matches the IPv4 address regex pattern.

methods.name: str normalize_device_type(value: str)
methods.description: Normalizes device type string to one of allowed types or defaults to 'other'.

methods.name: Tuple[Dict[str,Any],List[str]] sanitize_payload(payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Removes unknown fields and truncates long strings in the payload, returning sanitized payload and list of unknown fields.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,List[str],Dict[str,Any]] validate_create(payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Validates a payload for creating a device entry, checking required fields, IP address format, and normalizing device type.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,List[str],Dict[str,Any]] validate_update(payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Validates a payload for updating a device entry, allowing partial updates and normalizing device type.

ctags.name: sanitize_payload
ctags.pattern: /^def sanitize_payload(payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], List[str]]:$/

ctags.name: validate_create
ctags.pattern: /^def validate_create(payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[bool, List[str], Dict[str, Any]]:$/

ctags.name: validate_update
ctags.pattern: /^def validate_update(payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[bool, List[str], Dict[str, Any]]:$/
